context: User asked for an original stand-up bit about class and money with a strong build and a quotable close.

checklist.name: single contrastive claim
checklist.description: The bit is organized around one bold 'there's a difference between X and Y' claim rather than a disconnected list of jokes.

checklist.name: concrete escalating examples
checklist.description: Examples are concrete everyday scenes, not abstract statements, and later examples are more pointed or specific than earlier ones.

checklist.name: objector voiced and defeated
checklist.description: A brief imagined counter-argument appears and is knocked down without derailing the escalation.

checklist.name: unhedged aphoristic close
checklist.description: The bit ends on one tight, quotable line with no qualifier, disclaimer, or softening added after it.

checklist.name: originality
checklist.description: No line or example closely matches or paraphrases an identifiable existing comedian's material.
